messages:
nina p: quick follow-up from last night's cache paging noise. want clear action owners + short timelines so we dont keep getting repeat pages.
nina p: root cause: cache churn after deploy + aggressive alerting thresholds. proposed actions below, pls claim: 
  1) dedupe key audit and fix
  2) increase sustain windows for shard-level alerts
  3) paging routing tweak (warn->ops-queue unless sustained)
  4) 72h post-deploy noise monitoring
omar r: i'll take 1 (dedupe). will swap fingerprint from `instance`->`shard:metric` and add a unit test. ETA: Thu EOD (2023-11-16).
li z: i'll own 2. proposal: bump `for` to 90s for noisy shard alerts and add backoff so repeated flaps dont repage within 10m. ETA: today (2023-11-14).
mike g: i'll pick 3 and 4. routing PR to route brief spikes to #ops-queue; 72h monitor job scheduled after deploy, i'll post summary at 24/72h. ETA: PR by Mon AM (2023-11-20).
oncall-bot: Incident KV-2023-11-14 acknowledged by nina p. Temporary silence set by mike g until 2023-11-15T08:00Z.
omar r: small config snippet for dedupe idea:
```yaml
- labels:
    dedupe_key: "{{ $labels.shard }}:{{ $labels.alert_name }}"
```
li z: adding a sustain and backoff example:
```yaml
for: 90s
annotations:
  repage_suppress: 10m
```
li z: will run a staging replay to validate after omar's change lands.
omar r: will open PR and tag li_z for staging runs.
mike g: after deploy i'll kick off `scripts/noise-monitor --window 72h --rules redis-*` and paste results here.
nina p: please each drop a one-liner ETA so I can add to the PM tracker.
omar r: ETA Thu EOD (2023-11-16) - PR + tests.
li z: ETA 2023-11-14 EOD - config change + staging validation.
mike g: ETA 2023-11-20 AM - routing PR, monitor scheduled.
nina p: i'll update the postmortem with owners/timelines and schedule a 15m check-in next Wed to confirm closure. thanks :thumbsup: if anything blocks, reopen thread.
